M04.05.title: Escape pacemakers
M04.05.text: If the normal dominant pacemaker slows or impulses fail to reach lower tissue, an escape pacemaker may emerge.

M04.10.qualification: Supplemental explanation; no corresponding numerical/3D process or clinical prediction.

M04.11.title: What is an ion?
M04.11.text: Ions are atoms or molecules carrying an electrical charge.
M04.11.source: Owner-approved adapted M04 narration · source script lines 520-538;871-881
M04.11.qualification: Supplemental explanation; no corresponding numerical/3D process or clinical prediction.

M04.11.title: Positive and negative ions
M04.11.text: Sodium, potassium, calcium, and magnesium are positive ions; chloride is a negative ion.
M04.11.source: Owner-approved adapted M04 narration · source script lines 520-538;871-881
M04.11.qualification: Supplemental explanation; no corresponding numerical/3D process or clinical prediction.

M04.11.title: Electrical and chemical gradients
M04.11.text: Different concentrations inside and outside the cell, together with selective membrane permeability, create electrical and chemical gradients.
M04.11.source: Owner-approved adapted M04 narration · source script lines 520-538;871-881
M04.11.qualification: Supplemental explanation; no corresponding numerical/3D process or clinical prediction.

M04.11.title: Sodium-potassium pump: three out, two in
M04.11.text: The sodium-potassium pump uses A T P to move three sodium ions out and two potassium ions in.
M04.11.source: Owner-approved adapted M04 narration · source script lines 520-538;871-881
M04.11.qualification: Supplemental explanation; no corresponding numerical/3D process or clinical prediction.

M04.11.title: Gradient maintenance versus rapid channel currents
M04.11.text: This maintains gradients over time and indirectly supports calcium handling; channels carry the rapid currents of each action potential.
M04.11.source: Owner-approved adapted M04 narration · source script lines 520-538;871-881
M04.11.qualification: Supplemental explanation; no corresponding numerical/3D process or clinical prediction.
